cases.task_text: I'm thinking about a SaaS that helps independent physiotherapy clinics fill last-minute cancellations. Help me decide whether the problem is real, who would pay, and who already sells something like it.
The CSV export for finance users is approved. Please write the requirements for it and have engineering review the plan before anyone builds it.
The invoice total is off by one cent whenever a percentage discount is applied. Please fix it.
Our settings page feels cramped on phones. Audit it, fix what is wrong, then check it visually on a small screen.
Compare the public pricing pages of the three best-known crew-scheduling tools and tell me where we could position.
Put together a launch marketing plan for our bookkeeping course, including how we should position it.
Month-end invoicing takes our office four days. Work out why and propose a pilot that would shorten it measurably.
